method: Built-in imagegen precise-object-edit: remove baked UI, retain supplied composition; WebP format conversion without upscaling.
usageRights: User-supplied reference; rights review before redistribution.

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the edit target, not a style inspiration. Asset type: clean background plate for the existing Slay the Math game. Remove ALL baked game UI, including every panel, frame, card, icon, button, label, letter, number and HUD bar. Replace only those UI-covered regions with a seamless continuation of the existing dark blue stone dungeon wall and floor, quiet and low contrast on the right for live HTML controls. Preserve Alyssa standing on the left and the hooded elderly merchant behind the counter in the left-centre, exactly their existing faces, poses, armor and props. Preserve the exact existing painted fantasy anime art style, composition, camera, scene lighting, crimson hair, gold details and all non-UI scene pixels as closely as possible. Do not move or enlarge the character; keep the full body and feet inside the canvas with the same margin. Preserve the wide 1672:941 landscape aspect ratio. No UI, no lettering, no gold UI frames, no floating game cards, no new characters. Opaque background.
